case_reviews.locator: FY24 operations review, physical PDF p9, Viper and Graceland.
case_reviews.finding: The passive survey was undertaken, the proposed drilling did not proceed and relinquishment had commenced. No completed new development milestone or REE product is established for Viper.

case_reviews.locator: 2025-07-30 quarterly, physical PDF p4, four Southern Cross licences.
case_reviews.finding: Four licences were relinquished. The event verifies the operator's withdrawal, with no completed development milestone or REE product in that disclosure.

case_reviews.locator: Physical PDF pp.2,88–89, total row 379,421,288 t, MzEq cut-off 1,957 ppm.
case_reviews.finding: Appendix p88 distinguishes 344.6 ppm TREO from 374.3 ppm TREO plus yttrium oxide. The element sum includes yttrium; substituting the second denominator changes the defined ratio to the displayed TREO. Keep both published bases visible here.

case_reviews.locator: Physical PDF pp.1,12, Coondina RC drilling, JORC geology.
case_reviews.finding: The issuer interprets monzogranite on p1, but p12 explicitly leaves the REE host unresolved between alluvial/colluvial sediment and weathered granite or pegmatite.

case_reviews.locator: Static ASX PDF pp.1–2,7: Luni drilling, oxidised and primary intervals.
case_reviews.finding: Confirmed carbonatite mineralisation includes both near-surface supergene enrichment and deeper primary mineralisation. A unique deposit code for the full Luni scope is unresolved.

case_reviews.locator: September presentation p9, scheduled annual concentrate production; prior PFS identified on p2.
case_reviews.finding: Cross-checks the annual reporting period of the August PFS. The project-wide averages are read from the Total/Average column of the PFS, not the high-grade phase.

case_reviews.locator: 2025 DFS p109 Figure 42, concentrate REO assemblage and footnote 1.
case_reviews.finding: Steady-state contained TREO 4,350 t/y times (Pr 0.3% + Nd 1.7%) yields approximately 87 t/y NdPr oxides.
